name: M5.Connectivity.support_gcd_dvd
statement: ∀ (N d : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), d ∣ M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B ↔ d ∣ N ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b)
guidance: Unfold supportGcd, use Nat.dvd_gcd_iff and Finset.dvd_gcd_iff; id evaluates to identity. Preserve empty supports and zero exponents. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.
